title: New York Jets News: Jets take a partial day off at training camp

sources.title: New York Jets News: Jets take a partial day off at training camp
sources.description: Happy Saturday, Jets fans! Friday was a quiet day at the team facility. The team was not on the practice field at training camp. Instead Aaron Glenn had the Jets in the classroom and at meetings. The Jets will be back on the field today and have Sunday off entirely. It is a light workload […]
